data.title: Data collected
data.form: The form may submit your name, email address, subject and message, together with an anti-bot reCAPTCHA token needed to protect the form.
data.technical: When you use the website, technical browsing data may be processed by hosting, analytics, security or embedded services (for example, information about your device, browser and connection). The exact categories depend on the services used.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.body: Form data is used to receive, review and handle enquiries, reply to them and limit automated submissions. Technical data supports the operation, security, analytics and improvement of the website. Stored preferences are used to remember certain display choices.

recipients.title: Recipients and services
recipients.body: Enquiries are accessible to the people responsible for contact at KofCorporation. {websiteHost} hosts the website and provides Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights. Sanity provides the website's content management and delivery system. Google provides reCAPTCHA to protect the form and Google Maps only if you choose to display the map. Messages are sent using the SMTP service configured by KofCorporation on a VPS; {smtpHost} in the available information.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body: The currently published notice states a maximum retention period of 12 months for form data. KofCorporation must confirm this period. Retention periods applied by providers and periods for technical data must also be confirmed with those providers.

rights.title: Your rights and how to exercise them
rights.body: Subject to applicable rules, you may request access to your personal data, its correction or deletion, and request restriction of processing or object to it where those rights apply.
rights.contact: To exercise these rights or ask a question about your data, email {email} and describe your request.

storage.title: Cookies, local storage and cache
storage.locale: The NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers your chosen language. The one-year duration is the period stated in the currently published notice.
storage.theme: The display theme and cursor mode are stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage), under the keys theme and cursor-mode; these are not cookies.
storage.pwa: The application service worker may cache website resources to speed up loading and support some offline features. This cache is stored by your browser and can be cleared in its settings.
storage.recaptcha: Google reCAPTCHA is loaded when the contact form is submitted. Google may then process technical data and use storage mechanisms under its own policies.
storage.maps: Google Maps is not loaded until you click “Show map”. If you display it, your browser connects to Google, which may receive technical data and use its storage mechanisms.
